post.summary: Send a password-reset email. Always returns ok — neutral regardless of whether the account exists.
Re-send the signup confirmation email. Always returns ok — neutral regardless of whether the address maps to an unconfirmed account.
Create an account (ban/retired-username checks, referral + locale metadata). A confirmation email follows via the existing Supabase template.

get.summary: Runtime configuration, kill-switch and feature flags (unauthenticated, cacheable).

delete.summary: Unregister this device’s token (call before sign-out).

post.summary: Register (or move to this account) this device’s native FCM token.
Report an app crash/exception into client_error_logs. Works signed-out. Never fails the caller.

get.summary: Home: banners, live/upcoming tournaments, leaderboard teaser, hall-of-fame teaser, platform stats. Public — visible logged out, same as the web home page.

post.summary: Accept a season invitation — confirms immediately if free, else opens a Paystack transaction.
Decline a season invitation — cascades to the next invitee.

get.summary: The signed-in user, their roles (drives the role-aware Admin section) and own profile.

patch.summary: Update the signed-in player's own profile (display name, bio, country, one-time username change, avatar).

post.summary: Claim a username after email confirmation — resolveOnboardingGate’s first step.

get.summary: Poll a Paystack registration payment's confirmation status. The webhook remains the source of truth; this is UI polling only.

post.summary: Runs login()'s server-side side-effects (daily login coins/XP/streak) and reports deletion-pending status. Call once per app process after a session exists — not on every screen visit.

get.summary: Group standings, fixtures, and knockout rounds for one tournament.

post.summary: Register for a tournament — waiver, zero-fee, coin-discount-to-zero, or Paystack, in that precedence.

get.summary: Registration view-state, fee, waiver and coin-discount eligibility for one tournament, for the caller (or a logged-out guest).
Points-race stage standings (round-robin/BR). Group standings live in GET /tournaments/{id}/bracket instead.

post.summary: Join the waitlist once registration has closed — no payment step.
